notes.title: Collect ‘em all at the Creature Collector Fest
notes.content:
[h1]Fans of creature collecting games unite![/h1]

If you find yourself with the undeniable urge to rescue and collect every cute lil’ critter you come across in a video game, then the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/category/creature_collector]Creature Collector Fest[/url] is for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715741/2b24ade025ddd3722748f78fa478425a1a222f00.png[/img]

Alongside a host of other adorable titles, you’ll find our own cosy offering - Loddlenaut. 

Take to the ocean planet of GUP-14 in this relaxing ocean clean-up game set on a vibrant alien planet. Play as an interstellar custodian tasked with cleaning up the pollution left behind by an irresponsible mega-corporation. Befriend and care for local axolotl-like creatures called loddles as you explore the vibrant waters, picking up trash, blasting goo and reviving their habitats in Loddlenaut.

The event will run 12 May @ 10:00am PDT/19:00pm CET to 19 May @ 10:00am PDT/19:00pm CET where 🫧[b]Loddlenaut will be 55% off during the event[/b]🫧

Happy Creature Collecting!

notes.title: Make Wholesome Waves with our new three-game bundle!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’re extremely excited to announce a brand new bundle with our friends over at Hiwarp and Lente - Wholesome Waves!

This bundle features Loddlenaut and two other incredible indie games - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1813860/NAIAD/]NAIAD[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2240080/Spilled/]Spilled![/url] The bundle name fits pretty well, don’t you think?

If you want to swim or sail across new waters and haven’t picked up any of these three great games, the Wholesome Waves bundle will give you a sweet 10% discount! If you already own any of these three games, purchasing the bundle will only charge you for the games you don’t have, so you can complete the set. 

Alongside our pollution-clearing, creature-caring title from Moon Lagoon, Spilled! Also sees you clean ocean waste in your upgradeable boat, whilst NAIAD is a dreamy minimalist experience, where you engage with river flora and fauna to discover a memorable story. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715741/44116bbae8ff62266566a7520a7e37fe8e271ab2.png[/img]

Now if you’ll excuse us, we have some relaxing exploration and ocean cleaning to do.

- The Loddlenaut Team

notes.title: 1.2.4 Patch Notes - No more missing loddles!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We’ve got a tiny patch going live today that fixes two bugs recently identified by the community.

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing loddles to slowly swim back to the Home Cove (and possibly go under the map) when attempting to drop them off at a new biome after fast traveling.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed the storage menu to be openable (and invisible) during the ending sequence.
[/list]
- Loddlenaut Team

notes.title: 1.2.3 Patch Notes - A small batch of bug fixes!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We’ve just pushed a minor patch that fixes a few issues that were identified by the community since we released the Goddles Update. 

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Crystal Crisp and Crispy Cookie to the “Diet” section of relevant evolution cards in the Loddlepedia.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing litter that was destroyed due to the game reaching its item limit to not be removed from a biome's pollution tracking system.
[*] Fixed an issue that resulted in the Crafting Station menu occasionally displaying the incorrect item when it was opened while using a controller.
[*] Fixed an issue that resulted in certain patches of goop redundantly initializing themselves when a save file was loaded, which was increasing load times and causing crashes on Mac.
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing the tubey melons in the Main Menu to have their item sheen effect enabled.
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing following loddles to incorrectly pay attention to fruit that had just been plucked off a nearby plant by a non-following loddle.
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing lost loddles to not identify the Home Cove as a valid home location if they were cleaned and then followed the player back home after the player ran out of oxygen.
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing a biome’s clean objective to remain stuck at 99% when the biome was fully clean in-game. The game will now check for this situation and manually fix it when a save file is reloaded.
[/list]

We’re now going to be taking a break from development, but we’ll still be paying attention to bug reports, so we appreciate you folks notifying us of any issues you encounter!

- Loddlenaut Team

notes.title: 1.2.1 Patch Notes - The Goddles Update!
notes.content:
[h1]The Goddles Update is available NOW![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715741/20999b79e61845ec45c309e43741a408f0100f87.png[/img]
This major update adds Goddle Grotto, which is a new hidden cave biome that contains three primordial Goddles. Was this cavern forgotten by GUPPI? What ancient abilities do these Goddles have...?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715741/0f7969b4dd7df605e76ea2e69dcb0bcc0d740a80.png[/img]
We've also added an entirely new gardening system that'll allow you to collect seedlings, grow your own flora, and increase each biome's resistance to pollution. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715741/c9954ad45344ac9c7a80378020e67e00454b8577.png[/img]
But that's not all! Track the positions of all pollutants with the new Global Pollution Tracker, expand your backpack with the new Inventory Capacity Module, and acquire gold versions of your tools by completing different milestones that will ultimately unlock a modified ending cutscene. Plus, explore an expanded planet with three new caves that each contain a lost loddle with a new rare cosmetic mutation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715741/c7b18ddf67191c57591672b01435859ed09f4e03.png[/img]
There are a [i]ton[/i] of new details in this update. so continue reading for the complete patch notes!

[h2]1.2.0 Patch Notes - Goddles Update[/h2]

[h3]GODDLES![/h3]
Tucked away in the side of a cliff in Metzi Trench is the entrance to [b]Goddle Grotto[/b], an ancient cave that was left undiscovered by GUPPI. Inside this large cavern are three giant [b]Goddles[/b], which each have their own special ability that act as enhanced versions of the three existing loddle abilities (Purifying, Pollinating, and Energizing). These abilities have particularly unique effects when baby loddles are brought in the vicinity of a Goddle. Goddle Grotto also contains a new fruit-bearing plant that grows a crystalline apple called the [b]Crystal Crisp[/b], which can be used to create the new [b]Crispy Cookie[/b] loddle snack!

[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Track down every last pollutant in GUP-14 with the Global Pollution Tracker![/b]
This is a new purchasable upgrade at the Shipping Station that unlocks a new view of the World Map. This will unlock in the Shipping Station after you've completed Ripple Reef, Flotsam Flats, and Tangle Bay. This new map view displays all pollution across your discovered areas of GUP-14, with different toggleable icons for goop, litter, and microplastics. 
[*] [b]The new Pollution Resistance system prevents pollutants from returning in each biome![/b]
Biomes now have a "Pollution Resistance" value that is a measure of how many plants and Purifying loddles are in that area. Goop and litter will not respawn in biomes that have 100% Pollution Resistance.
[*] [b]Grow lush flora across GUP-14 with the new gardening system![/b]
Seedlings now have a rare chance to spawn after collecting fruit from a plant. You can plant these seedlings in fertile plots of sand that are now scattered in each biome. These plants grow fruit and increase the Pollution Resistance of their surrounding biome!
[*] [b]Expand your inventory with the Inventory Capacity Module![/b]
The Inventory Capacity Module is a new purchasable upgrade at the Shipping Station that adds a fifth row of slots to the inventory, increasing the total inventory size to 25 slots. This will unlock in the Shipping Station after you collect an Electronic Bit for the first time. Also, the Storage inventory in the your spaceship has been expanded to 56 slots by default (up from 52).
[*] [b]Discover shiny, radiant, and ghostly loddles with new rare cosmetic loddle variants![/b]
Newly hatched loddles now have a rare chance to be born with one of three cosmetic mutations! These are subtle visual flourishes on baby loddles that will carry over into their adult form. "Shiny" loddles have a metallic shine, "Radiant" loddles are bright and glowy, and "Ghostly" loddles have lighter pastel colors. There are also different things you can do to ensure an adult loddle lays an egg with one of these cosmetic mutations! A diet full of Crystal Crisps will result in an egg containing a Shiny baby loddle, a loddle that has blinked their cheek pads at you many times will lay an egg that contains a Radiant baby loddle, and a loddle that has a spent a long time following you will lay an egg that contains a Ghostly baby loddle.
[*] [b]Delve into three new small caves across GUP-14, each containing a special baby loddle![/b]
These three tiny caves contain additional pollutants and one lost baby loddle. These lost loddles are guaranteed to have one of the three new cosmetic variants.
[*] [b]Acquire golden versions of your equipment by completing various milestones![/b]
After you reach certain completion milestones (100% clean ocean, all biomes fully diverse, and all biomes fully pollution-resistant), Dave will send packages to the Home Cove that give you golden versions of your existing tools!
[*] [b]Unlock an alternate ending cutscene![/b]
An adjusted ending cutscene with new text and music will now play when you complete the ending sequence after you have restored all of GUP-14 (i.e. you have reached all of the milestones for golden equipment).
[/list]
[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with loddles always wanting to follow the player after being cleaned without the use of the Recharge Ring.
[*] Fixed an issue with goopy loddles not being detected by the Scanner Pointer Module on new saves.
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing the camera to have jittery rotational movement at exceedingly low or high framerates.
[/list]
[b]EDIT[/b] (September 20) - Hotfix patch [b]1.2.2[/b] is now live with the following fix:
[list]
[*] Mac - Fixed an issue that was causing late-game save files to crash on startup.
[/list]
That's all for now! We hope you enjoy this expanded version of the game <3

- Loddlenaut Team

notes.title: 1.1.0 Patch Notes - Loddlepedia Update! (and a loddle plushie?!)
notes.content:
[h1]The Loddlepedia Update is available NOW![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715741/f64d3394cd2c1e0c0e5f6e9b31fda942cd6539c9.png[/img]

This free update adds the much-requested [b]Loddlepedia[/b], which is a new menu that keeps track of all the loddle evolutions you've encountered!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715741/8ebdad5561f183a5b5df61f12f66252b897ebf38.png[/img]
We've also got a new loddle ability, a new type of cleanable plant, a new loddle personality system, biome diversity ratings, and a few more lost baby loddles for you to find throughout GUP-14! Check out the full patch notes later in this post for more details. 

But first, speaking of baby loddles...

[h2][b]YOU CAN NOW GET A BABY LODDLE PLUSHIE![/b][/h2]

[url=https://www.makeship.com/products/baby-loddle-plush][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40715741/091f6467f3b8f91a8f9f4e0db1070e0e172e4595.png[/img][/url]

We've seen all of your questions about an official loddle plushie, and we were finally able to collaborate with Makeship to bring you this baby blue loddle! These [b]limited edition plushies[/b] are available to order for the next 22 days, and they'll only get made if enough people place an order, so go snag your very own baby loddle via this link: https://www.makeship.com/products/baby-loddle-plush


[h2]Now, onto the patch notes for v1.1.0![/h2]

[h3]The Loddlepedia![/h3]
This new menu can be accessed to the right of the Holo-Badges tab. It contains cards with brand new art for each of the 13 loddle evolutions in the game! Before you've encountered a specific evolution, its card will display a darkened silhouette. Once revealed, each loddle card can be selected to display information about that evolution's ability, physical features, and diet. The cards will also play all the different loddle vocalization sounds when they're selected!

[h3]Other New Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Boost Overdrive gives you extra speed while you're swimming across GUP-14![/b]
When Overdrive is triggered, your boost meter is immediately refilled and you have a brief period of increased boost speed (during which your boost meter will not deplete). As for what triggers overdrive...
[*] [b]Energy Sprout plants have appeared across GUP-14![/b]
These plants will emit energy particles once they're all cleaned up and they'll trigger Overdrive once you swim over them. The sprouts will then close up and recharge for 10 seconds before they can trigger Overdrive again.
[*] [b]A new Energize ability has been given to four of the existing loddle evolutions![/b]
Loddles with this ability will periodically emit a pulse that maxes out happiness for all nearby loddles and triggers your Overdrive if you're close enough to the pulse.
[*] [b]Personality traits are now randomly assigned to every loddle.[/b]
Most of these traits will make loddles get very happy when they perform a certain action (e.g. a Chatty loddle *really* likes it when you blink your helmet lights at them). A couple traits change the loddle's behavior in a subtle visual way, and there's also a chance for loddles to be born without a specific trait. There are eight personality traits in total!
[*] [b]A new Diversity rating can now be seen in the menu for each biome.[/b]
This 3-star rating system represents how diverse the biome's loddle population is. Loddles will have slower mood depletion rates in biomes with higher Diversity ratings, which means they'll stay happier for longer periods of time. Be sure to bring plenty of different loddle evolutions into every biome to max out their Diversity ratings!
[*] [b]Three new lost loddles can now be found outside of the main biomes.[/b]
Be sure to explore the non-biome areas if you want to rescue these little fellas! 
[*] [b]Autosave will now trigger more frequently![/b]
The game will now silently autosave whenever the main in-game menu (where you see the Objectives, World Map, etc.) is closed. This autosave has a cooldown period of 3 minutes to prevent overly frequent saves.[/list]
[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ambient critters will now start spawning when biomes are above 66% clean, as opposed to 100% clean.
[*] Happy evolved loddles will now activate their abilities at a slightly increased rate.
[*] Tutorial tooltips have been added in the equipment menu, in case you ever forget how to use a specific tool.
[*] "NEW" labels will now appear above newly unlocked recipes and orders in the Crafting and Shipping stations.
[*] The "All Grown Up" achievement will now trigger when you approach your first loddle evolution, rather than when a loddle evolves from a cocoon for the first time.[/list]
[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the plastic Recycle Bot not closing after microplastics are deposited.
[*] Fixed an issue with Shipping Station tabs displaying incorrectly when multiple mouse clicks were detected in rapid succession.
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing the Bubble Gun laser to have jittery movement at low framerates.
[*] Fixed an issue with certain loddles not displaying the proper emote when told to "Stay Here" outside of a valid home location.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed certain in-game menus to be opened on the same frame as the pause menu.
[/list]
[b]EDIT[/b] (June 27) - Hotfix patch [b]1.1.1[/b] is now live with the following fix:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing loddles to evolve with incorrect secondary colors.
[/list]
[b]EDIT[/b] (July 1) - Hotfix patch [b]1.1.2[/b] is now live with the following fix:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing buttons in the main menu to be unresponsive when the game was launched using Brazilian Portuguese as the language.
[/list]
We have another (even bigger) update in store for later this year... But until then, we hope you enjoy the Loddlepedia Update!

- Loddlenaut Team

notes.title: 1.0.22 Patch Notes - Jingle Shells for everyone!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Our holiday event is now over, but we’ve decided to keep the Jingle Shells item (which was contained in the hidden gift box) permanently in the game! We appreciate the feedback that has been shared about limited-time events like this, and we’ll be sure to keep all of that in mind for future holiday events.

We’ve also got a few small bug fixes in this patch, so check out the notes below for more details.

[h3]Jingle Shells![/h3]
[list]
[*] The festive loddle toy that was introduced in December is now a permanent craftable item! 
[*] The recipe for this toy is unlocked alongside the recipes for the Kelp Chew and the Loddle Buddy. If you already had these two recipes unlocked, you should now see a Jingle Shells recipe when you visit the Crafting Station.
[*] If you haven’t yet unlocked the recipes for the Kelp Chew and the Loddle Buddy, you can do so by petting a loddle for the first time.
[/list]
[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The “Who Needs Oxygen?” achievement now only requires you to run out of oxygen once instead of ten times. To anyone who already completed the achievement: We admire your dedication, and we’re sorry for how tedious it was!
[*] The fifth inventory hotbar slot can now be highlighted by pressing 5 on the keyboard.
[*] The delay before quick depositing starts (triggered by holding out an item near a Recycle Bot) has been reduced.
[*] Settings configured via the Options menu (except for custom keybinds) will no longer be stored in the Steam Cloud, allowing for different settings configurations on different devices (e.g. Steam Deck vs. desktop PC).
[/list]
[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused objectives to not be tracked properly after switching away from the Objectives tab.
[*] Fixed an issue with ceiling lights in GUPPI Campus shining through walls.
[*] Fixed an issue with a Star Kelp tree outside of Tangle Bay not correctly saving and loading.
[*] Fixed an issue with Recycle Bots enabling the collection of partially nibbled fruit.
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing the wrong item to be removed from your inventory when tossing an entire item stack using the mouse.
[*] Mac - Fixed an issue that was hiding higher resolution options after a lower resolution option was selected.
[/list]

- Loddlenaut Team

notes.title: Gift of GUPPI event extended throughout January
notes.content:
[h3]Happy New Year, everyone![/h3]

We've decided to extend our holiday event to last throughout the rest of this month. This means you'll have a few more weeks to find the hidden gift box and to play around with the item it contains!

The gift box and the holiday item will be in the game until [b]February 1st at 10am US Central Time[/b]. After that, you won't be able to find the gift box anywhere and the holiday item will no longer be in your inventory (if you collected it). 

We've read feedback from some of you about the potential downsides of limited-time content like this, so we will be keeping all of your comments in mind as we plan any future holiday events. If you don't get a chance to find the holiday item this time around, don't worry! We're thinking about adding a permanent mechanic that has a similar effect in a future update. 

Thank you all for making 2023 such a wonderful launch year for us. Here's to a great 2024!

- Loddlenaut Team

notes.title: 1.0.2 Patch Notes - The “Gift of GUPPI” Update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We’ve been absolutely thrilled to see the positive response that Loddlenaut has received since its release last month, and we’ve spent the past few weeks working on a festive little update for all of you! Lots of quality-of-life changes and bug fixes in this one, plus a special limited-time gift that is hidden somewhere on GUP-14! Check out the full patch notes below for more details:

[h2]A Gift from GUPPI?[/h2]
[list]
[*] A mysterious gift box has appeared in the waters of GUP-14! Who left it there? What does it contain?! You’ll need to explore the eastern parts of the ocean to find this yule-tide treasure…
[*] This gift box (and the item it contains) will only be available from December 18th to January 4th, so be sure to find it while you can!
[/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added an extra column of slots to the inventory, increasing the number of inventory slots from 16 to 20.
[*] Added a 60-minute period of “biome protection” that is triggered whenever a biome is 100% cleaned. During this period, no goop or litter will respawn in that biome.
[*] When the final biome is 100% cleaned, there is a “global protection” period that starts and prevents goop from respawning in all biomes. The duration of this protection period has been extended from 20 minutes to 60 minutes. It now also prevents litter from respawning during this period.
[*] Loddles with the cleaning ability can now clear the goop off of nearby goopy loddles. The same goes for Purifier Bombs and Water Purifier stations.
[*] Added tutorial messages for using the Scrap Vac and the Puddle Scrubber.
[*] Added a controls prompt that displays whenever a structure is highlighted in the hotbar.
[*] The Scrap Vac is now made available to order at the Shipping Station after entering Tangle Bay for the first time. The previous trigger for this unlock (entering a cloud of microplastics) is still active.
[*] Shortened the delay before auto-deposit kicks in when holding a piece of litter in front of a Recycle Bot and increased the auto-deposit drop rate.
[*] Changed color of goop particles below Puddle Scrubber to more closely match the color of the goop puddles.
[*] Increased the text size of Options menu dropdown lists, Shipping Station flavor text, inventory item labels, and glyphs for LB / RB and LT / RT.
[*] Improved visibility of “100% clean” text in the World Map.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused dropped items to ignore collision with terrain.
[*] Fixed an issue with Siren Form loddles having increased ability range and a shortened ability activation interval.
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing the player and spaceship map icons to have slightly inaccurate positions, which was making it difficult to clear the top-right map segment.
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing the screen to stay dark when opening the World Map immediately after fast traveling.
[*] Fixed an issue with Light Beacons disabling their lights when the player got too close to them.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Pause button detecting input while the Equipment Menu was open. Pressing the Pause button while in the Equipment Menu will now close the Equipment Menu.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Inventory and Scanner buttons detecting input during the ending cutscene.
[*] Fixed an issue with the "Feed a loddle" objective getting completed before it has been unlocked.
[*] Fixed an issue with new objectives not getting properly saved if they were unlocked immediately after a fast travel, which would occur when fast traveling out of a biome that was just 100% cleaned for the first time.
[*] Adjusted the targeting animation to result in fewer instances of the arm bending behind the player’s back when targeting an item immediately after boosting.
[*] Mac - Fixed an issue with an Escape character being added to loddle names when renaming loddles via keyboard input.
[/list]

[b]EDIT[/b] (December 22) - Hotfix patch [b]1.0.21[/b] is now live with the following fix:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue the "Feed a loddle" objective not completing if a loddle had already eaten food before the objective was unlocked.
[/list]

Happy holidays!


- Loddlenaut Team

notes.title: 1.0.1 Patch Notes - Balance changes and bug fixes!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’ve got a small update for all of you! This patch should fix many of the day 1 bugs and address some common points of feedback. More improvements are in the works, but for now, check out the list below to see what we’ve changed and fixed!

[h2][b]Balance Changes:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced global goop respawn chance by 35%.
[*] Reduced global litter respawn chance by 60%.
[*] Litter and goop will now only respawn inside of biomes.
[*] Increased boost speed multiplier by 10%.
[*] Increased the duration of the default and upgraded boost.
[*] Reduced the boost meter recharge delay.
[*] Increased boost meter regeneration speed.
[*] Increased default Scrap Vac capacity from 10,000 to 15,000 microplastics.
[*] Increased upgraded Scrap Vac capacity from 15,000 to 30,000 microplastics.
[*] Increased Scrap Vac deposit speed.
[*] Increased brightness of all glowing effects on the Scrap Vac to make the capacity meter more noticeable.
[*] Loddles will now seek out fruit growing from plants when they’re hungry. Previously, this food-seeking behavior only triggered once they became starving.
[/list]

[h2][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed the Storage, Fast Travel, Shipping, and Crafting Menus to be opened while in structure placement mode.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused following loddles to not remove themselves from the “following player” list when they were released into the open ocean, which was eventually resulting in no new loddles being able to follow you.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Equipment Menu being opened on top of the World Map menu if the two buttons were pressed on the same frame.
[*] Added additional targeting logic to detect when an item has somehow become lodged inside of a wall or other collider. Those items will now be targetable and collectable.
[*] Fixed an issue with favorite fruits not giving loddles an extra boost of happiness.
[*] Fixed an issue with Puffer Form loddles having increased ability range and a shortened ability activation interval.
[/list]
That’s all for now! Huge thanks to everyone who has played the game, given us a review, and provided feedback on the Steam forums or in our Discord server. We’ll see you in the next update!

- Loddlenaut Team

notes.title: Loddlenaut review: a cute, but simple ocean clean-up adventure
notes.content:
The ocean planet of GUP-14 is not a happy place. Its seabed has been gunked up with piles of trash, globs of purple gunge and nasty clouds of micro-plastics, all because an industrial megacorp couldn't be bothered to clean up after themselves after bleeding it for resources. That megacorp's since upped sticks to, sadly, continue their terrible ways somewhere else in the solar system, but calling out these bad practices (beyond them being obviously bad and not good for the planet) is not really Loddlenaut's concern here.

Rather, your job is to simply clean up this mess with your array of high-tech gadgetry, healing its polluted environments so: a) it's not a grim, purple hellscape anymore; b) native, axolotl-like loddle creatures can move back in and prosper. It's simple, satisfying work that's designed to make you feel warm and fuzzy inside without having to think too hard. But its straightforward, frictionless tale may leave some wishing it had just a little more bite, and less of a sense that you're laying the ground for some other faceless corpo power to go and splurge all over it again.

notes.title: Secret Mode Partners with Moon Lagoon to publish Loddlenaut 🐠
notes.content:
Secret Mode is pleased to confirm it has partnered with indie team Moon Lagoon to publish the upcoming creature-raising survival game [url=https://youtu.be/H_8Z3KKbbvY]Loddlenaut[/url]. Loddlenaut was first revealed in 2021's Wholesome Direct conference as the show's ‘one last surprise’ game, and it was subsequently funded through Kickstarter in July 2021. [b]The full game is coming to PC and Mac in 2023.   [/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1644940/Loddlenaut/]Loddlenaut [/url]is a single-player adventure and survival game where players assume the role of an interstellar custodian sent to clean up a polluted ocean planet, repurposing marine debris and taking care of axolotl-like alien creatures called “Loddles”. 🐠 

“Loddlenaut's announcement made a big splash with everybody in the office," says Paige Dolan, Greenlight Manager at Secret Mode. "When Secret Mode was founded last year, our core identities were wrapped up in the lines: '[i]We believe that games are for everyone, and that creativity has no limits. We believe quality and fun are everything[/i].' Loddlenaut completely encapsulates those values. Combined with the game's messaging about climate care - a topic very close to the heart of our team - [i]Loddlenaut[/i] is the perfect title to join the Secret Mode ranks." 

“When we began Loddlenaut as a grad school project inspired by some games from our childhood, we had no idea where it might take us,” says Ricardo Escobar, co-founder of Moon Lagoon. “We wouldn't be where we are without our wonderful community and our Kickstarter backers. We are thrilled to be partnering with the amazing folks at Secret Mode, and with their help we can now expand our vision and bring Loddlenaut to an even wider audience.” 

Please stay tuned for more information on Loddlenaut later this year. 🔫
